name: Plague Marine

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: The Plague Marine may use Ruin actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: The Plague Marine gains bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this threat must make a DN 3 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks this Threat makes this Round.

abilities.name: Noxious Discharge
abilities.text: Whenever this Threat takes a Wound, roll a d6. If you roll an Icon, a mix of virulent gases and toxic effluent spills from the Wound. The Noxious Discharge hits every target Engaged with the Plague Marine. Noxious Discharge: 2 +4 ED / AP -4 / Blast (4), Inflict (Poison 4)

determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 8d6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.
note: Reprint of the Plague Marine option on chaos-space-marine (Core p.343); differs in Wounds 14 (12), Speed 6 (5), Tier row and weapons (Bolt pistol and Bubotic Axe, not Plague Belcher and Plague Sword). Faction heretic: no DAEMON keyword. Noxious Discharge has no range, so it stays REACTION text.
